_comment: Public endpoints probed by scripts/uptime-check.mjs on a schedule.
This replaces the availability monitoring that lived in the
jasperfordesq-ai/api.project-nexus.net repository, which was archived on
2026-08-10. Archiving a repository disables its scheduled workflows.
🔴 The ASP.NET API (api.project-nexus.net) and Web UK frontend
(uk.project-nexus.net) were REMOVED from this list on 2026-08-10, when the
owner retired them. Their containers were stopped deliberately, so both
hosts now return 503 by design. Monitoring a service you switched off on
purpose is how a monitor teaches its owner to ignore it.
If either is ever restarted, add it back with track 'experimental'.
Every entry MUST be an unauthenticated GET against a public URL. Do not
add an endpoint that requires a credential, mutates state, or is not
already public - this file is committed to a PUBLIC repository.

targets.name: Accessible frontend is web-uk (not a silent fallback to Blade)
